mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS id, a.receipt_code AS receipt_code, a.receipt_status AS receipt_status, a.door_car_id as door_car_id, b.car_number AS car_number, c.`name`, c.phone FROM biz_receipt_send_car_head a LEFT JOIN dic_car b ON a.car_id = b.id LEFT JOIN dic_driver c ON a.driver_id = c.id WHERE a.receipt_status IN (130) and a.is_delete = 0

SELECT a.id AS id, a.receipt_code AS receipt_code, a.receipt_status AS receipt_status, a.door_car_id as door_car_id, b.car_number AS car_number, c.`name`, c.phone FROM biz_receipt_send_car_head_mj a LEFT JOIN dic_car b ON a.car_id = b.id LEFT JOIN dic_driver c ON a.driver_id = c.id WHERE a.receipt_status IN (144) and a.remark = 0 and a.is_delete = 0

SELECT a.id AS id, a.receipt_code AS receipt_code, a.receipt_status AS receipt_status, a.door_car_id as door_car_id, b.car_number AS car_number, c.`name`, c.phone FROM biz_receipt_send_car_head a LEFT JOIN dic_car b ON a.car_id = b.id LEFT JOIN dic_driver c ON a.driver_id = c.id WHERE a.id = ${id}
